integrity: Complete proof and a finite independently formulated rational-grid checker are included. Finite computation does not establish the all-real theorem.
scientific_limitations: Real scalar field and dimension three only. No classification of nonmaximum cliques or higher dimensions. The 2022 orthograph survey was not fully inspected; unindexed overlap is possible. No independent scientific audit was performed.
title: The six-line rigidity theorem for mutual Birkhoff--James orthogonality in real \(\ell_1^3\)
